questions.question: Mohini is taller than Nita but not shorter than Sarita. Sarita and Malini are of same height. Mohini is shorter than Hema. Among them, who is the second tallest?
questions.solution:
As per the given information,

1) Mohini is taller than Nita but not shorter than Sarita:

Mohini > Nita, Mohini = Sarita

2) Sarita and Malini are of same height:

Sarita = Malini

3) Mohini is shorter than Hema:

Hema > Mohini

Combine the all statements:

Hema > Malini = Sarita = Mohini > Nita

From the given statements, it is clear that Mohini is shorter than only Hema. 

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In each of the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some pens are pencils.

II. All pencils are erasers.

III. Some erasers are cups.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pens are cups.

II. Some pencils are cups.

III. Some cups are pencils.

IV. Some erasers are pens.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/899207ec8b2b88950b621b26eabf78d1e0fe2b42cc8bb6d98a4eae256052ac05.png] 

**Conclusion: **

I) Some pens are cups → It is possible but not definite, hence false.

II) Some pencils are cups → It is possible but not definite, hence false.

III) Some cups are pencils → It is possible but not definite, hence false.

IV) Some erasers are pens → As some pens are pencils, and all pencils are erasers, some erasers will definitely be the pens.

Hence, Only conclusion (IV) follows.
